schedule.heatmapHint: GitHub-style grid · click to set YO
schedule.markHint: Letters and color come from the profile. Here you set tables and hours.
schedule.playersHint: Hours = marks ÷ 2. Remaining counts only slots that have not passed in CET.
schedule.noShifts: No shifts of yours on this day
schedule.analyticsHint: Limit {{limit}} is open. Only this field is counted.

cabinet.title: Profile
cabinet.lead: Member card. Fields are still being agreed — this is a layout.

capacity.title: Capacity by CET hour
capacity.lead: Pick a limit and a matrix: month 31×24 or week 7×24. Click to set depth, then save.
capacity.matrixHint: One hour is 2 slots. The number on the right is the day total. Cell color is depth.
capacity.conflictHint: If a weekday rule and a month-day rule both apply, the stricter one wins: the lower capacity in each hour.
capacity.previewLook: How these days look on the schedule. Light cells are open, hatch is closed.
capacity.needSelect: Select days in the grid first.
capacity.resetLimitHint: Restores the shared rule: day 1, night 2. A day has 64 slots: 48 in the row plus 16 at night.
capacity.resetSelectedHint: Selected days go back to day 1 and night 2.
capacity.halfHint: One hour is 2 slots, one row is 48. Night at capacity 2 adds 16 more, 64 in the day.
capacity.specialDay: Day {{day}} has its own capacity rule.
capacity.equalize: Apply maximum capacity to every day
capacity.equalizeHint: If one date has capacity 3 and another has 1, the second day shows two fully locked levels. Day rows stay the same height.
capacity.daysHint: Unmarked dates use the All days rule. Click a date for its own rule. You can select several dates at once.
capacity.maxHint: This many rows will appear for the limit in one day
capacity.editHint: Click to raise capacity, right-click to lower it. Click and drag to paint several hours.
capacity.previewHint: Light cells are open half-hour slots. Hatch means the level is closed. One row is 48 slots.

tip.lockedHint: This hour has capacity {{cap}}. Marks are allowed when capacity is at least {{need}}.
tip.markTables: Left click adds tables, right click removes them. The current number is saved on the slot and does not change later.
